# Open Exploration Publishing

> A peer-reviewed open-access academic publishing platform indexed by DOAJ, COPE, Scopus, and PubMed, specializing in medical and scientific research with AI-driven analysis tools.

Open Exploration Publishing provides open-access journals across multiple medical specialties including endocrinology, immunology, and neurology. The platform combines traditional peer-review standards with modern machine learning technologies for research analysis and comparison.

## Publishing Platform

- [Open Exploration Publishing](https://ssl.explorationpub.com/): Main homepage featuring DOAJ, COPE, Scopus, and PubMed indexing with information about open-access journals and publishing standards

## Research & Analysis

- [Exploration of Neuroprotective Therapy](https://www.explorationpub.com/Journals/Tables/100434/T1): Comparison table of neuroprotective therapy approaches using machine learning and deep learning AI algorithms for neurological disease analysis
